recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中可見多顆細胞核偏於一側、細胞質深藍且有核旁淡染區（perinuclear hof）的成熟漿細胞，散在於正常造血細胞之間，比例看起來偏高，符合漿細胞增多。
features: Increased scattered mature-appearing plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei
Deeply basophilic cytoplasm with a perinuclear clear zone (hof)
Clock-face (coarsely clumped) chromatin without prominent nucleoli
Plasma cells are interspersed singly rather than forming sheets
Background trilineage hematopoiesis with lymphocytes, granulocytes and erythroid precursors
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows trilineage hematopoiesis with numerous lymphocytes and an increased number of scattered plasma cells. The plasma cells are mature-appearing, with eccentric nuclei, clumped chromatin, basophilic cytoplasm and perinuclear hofs, and occur singly without sheets or significant nuclear atypia. Findings are consistent with plasmacytosis; a differential count, CD138 immunostaining with kappa/lambda light chain assessment and serum protein studies are needed to distinguish reactive plasmacytosis from a plasma cell neoplasm.

ddx.vs: Usually shows clonal plasma cells ≥10% often in clusters or sheets with atypia (binucleation, nucleoli, immature forms), confirmed by light chain restriction, whereas reactive plasmacytosis is polytypic and interstitial.
Contains a spectrum of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells with increased mast cells and an IgM paraprotein/MYD88 L265P mutation.
Small lymphoid cells have scant cytoplasm and central nuclei without the eccentric nucleus and perinuclear hof of plasma cells.
